Name: TID_TUTORIAL_3_TEXT
Text: Click on the ground to move around.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_0_TEXT
Text: Characters with exclamation mark give missions. Click on the character to get one.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_1_TEXT
Text: You have completed a mission! Click to collect your reward.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_4_TEXT
Text: Click on the glowing arrow to move from one area to another.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_2_TEXT
Text: Use special combat moves to maximize damage!\n\nFirst click the enemy once and then click this skill icon.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_5_TEXT
Text: Click here to use your damage booster!

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_7_TEXT
Text: Click here, then click a target location to throw.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_8_TEXT
Text: Click on the other side of the border to move to the next area.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_9_TEXT
Text: In addition to the game world, the map shows your active missions and their locations.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_11_TEXT
Text: You are running out of health! Click on a medikit to heal yourself.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_12_TEXT
Text: This is a multiplayer meeting area.\nMeeting areas are the best places to join up with other players for a group adventure.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_13_TEXT
Text: Click to smash the barrel and create chain reaction.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_15_TEXT
Text: Click the portal to enter an area designed for groups. You and your mercenary make up a small group. You can also form bigger groups with other players to take on extreme challenges.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_16_TEXT
Text: When you gain levels, remember to buy new skills from skill trainers.\nThe new skills will automatically appear in your quickbar.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_18_TEXT
Text: Follow the arrow to your next objective.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_19_TEXT
Text: Move mouse cursor here and click HIRE when it appears!

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_20_TEXT
Text: Diamonds are your shortcut to happiness. Buy diamonds to instantly access high quality equipment.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_21_TEXT
Text: This must be a joke of some kind! Where are they taking me?

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_22_TEXT
Text: This is no joke after all! I have to get out of here...

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_23_TEXT
Text: Finally some friendly folks. I might make it out of here after all!

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_24_TEXT
Text: Labycore keeps trying to kill me. Basically the island government are all bad guys!

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_25_TEXT
Text: Grim Gonzales? Sounds like a scary guy!

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_26_TEXT
Text: That's how you equip items.\nClose the inventory by clicking the Inventory icon.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_27_TEXT
Text: Skills consume your energy that regenerates after the combat. Fill up the energy meter faster by using energy boosters.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_28_TEXT
Text: Glowing objects are mission objectives.\nClick glowing objects to use them.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_29_TEXT
Text: Look, a bazooka! Pick it up.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_30_TEXT
Text: To complete certain missions you need to travel to other areas. Use your map to quickly jump from one area to another.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_6_TEXT
Text: Got stranded on this island after a shipwreck... Let's find out what is this place.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_17_TEXT
Text: Click on an enemy to attack.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_31_TEXT
Text: Click here to craft a melee weapon.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_32_TEXT
Text: Using mercenaries is vital in tough fights. Invite your friends to Gunshine - you can hire their characters for a lot less than regular mercenaries!

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_33_TEXT
Text: Switch to your gun (key: '<SHORTCUT>space</SHORTCUT>').

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_34_TEXT
Text: Click on objects to pick them up.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_35_TEXT
Text: Click on the Bags icon and try wearing your new coat!

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_36_TEXT
Text: Open Crafting Screen.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_37_TEXT
Text:
Craft some grenades
to boost your attacks.
Choose 'items' tab
under the crafting menu.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_38_TEXT
Text: When I get to Pirate Bay, I'm going to pay these guys back for their help.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_39_TEXT
Text: Okay, this it. I'm going to join the fight for real! Time to slay the TROLL!

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_40_TEXT
Text: Click to select target.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_41_TEXT
Text: Click the <SHORTCUT>Craft</SHORTCUT> button to build weapons and items.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_42_TEXT
Text: Click to start crafting an item.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_43_TEXT
Text: You got a new weapon! Click to collect it.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_44_TEXT
Text: No time to waste now! Speed up the crafting with one diamond.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_45_TEXT
Text: Pick up the ingredients to craft a weapon.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_46_TEXT
Text: Click to join a multiplayer fight against a tough enemy!

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_47_TEXT
Text: Click here to join a group of other players.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_48_TEXT
Text: Buy some gear before your showdown with Grim Gonzales!

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_49_TEXT
Text: Close the Crafting Screen.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_55_TEXT
Text: Click on the person to talk.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_10_TEXT
Text: Click the 'Ranged weapons' tab.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_51_TEXT
Text: Click to start crafting.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_52_TEXT
Text: Click to collect your item.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_53_TEXT
Text: Close the Crafting Screen.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_57_TEXT
Text: Buy Medikits.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_58_TEXT
Text: Close the Shop.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_50_TEXT
Text: Click to complete mission.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_54_TEXT
Text: Click on the ground to throw!

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_56_TEXT
Text: Select item type.

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_14_TEXT
Text: So I have to shoot at \qlive targets\q? How weird...

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_59_TEXT
Text: Click here for fullscreen mode!

Name: TID_TUTORIAL_60_TEXT
Text: Special item received! Clothes like hats boost your performance in a combat. View and equip the items in your inventory!
